top_catalysts.event: September hiring slows and prior payroll gains are revised lower
top_catalysts.status: 已发生；按历史截止线重建
top_catalysts.what_happened: BLS reported 29,000 September payroll additions and 4.2% unemployment. July and August payrolls were revised down by 60,000 combined; the release was October 2 at 08:30EDT.
top_catalysts.what_changed: New hiring and revisions give a weaker employment picture than the prior publication; this is a first-release comparison, not a claim that recession began.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: Retrospective conditional analysis: Less hiring can reduce overheating risk but also weaken demand. The effect on long-duration assets depends on inflation and whether long yields follow the policy-rate repricing.
top_catalysts.transmission: 招聘减速→需求与政策约束再平衡；不能直接等同于降息。 UST2Y is the first observable transmission channel, not a guaranteed price direction.
top_catalysts.direction: 双向，取决于后续数据与市场确认
top_catalysts.confirmation: Later labor reports confirm softer hiring and wage pressure without offsetting evidence of renewed cost inflation.
top_catalysts.invalidation: Upward revisions or resilient activity and prices prevent the hiring slowdown from becoming a broader easing signal.

top_catalysts.event: European diesel reserve-release reports add a supply buffer
top_catalysts.status: 已发生；按历史截止线重建
top_catalysts.what_happened: Reuters reported European agreement to release diesel reserves on October 2. Brent settled at $102.25 and WTI at $91.11; the late-session figures were not available at the October 2 Asian cutoff.
top_catalysts.what_changed: Policy supply relief entered the information set, but a reported agreement is different from barrels physically delivered to consumers.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: Retrospective conditional analysis: The relevant channel runs through diesel availability and transport costs. A crude-price response alone cannot prove that refined-product tightness has been resolved.
top_catalysts.transmission: 储备投放→成品油溢价→通胀风险。 European diesel is the first observable transmission channel, not a guaranteed price direction.
top_catalysts.direction: 双向，取决于后续数据与市场确认
top_catalysts.confirmation: Verified stock releases arrive and cash-product tightness eases alongside transport-cost pressure.
top_catalysts.invalidation: Implementation stalls or new refinery and shipping disruptions offset the additional available stocks.

top_catalysts.event: September manufacturing remains expansionary while input-cost pressure rises
top_catalysts.status: 已发生；按历史截止线重建
top_catalysts.what_happened: ISM manufacturing was 54.5 in September; the prices index rose to 77.9 from 71.1 and new orders reached 55.3. These are diffusion measures, not inflation rates.
top_catalysts.what_changed: The headline softened slightly from 54.6 while costs rose, so a stable activity reading conceals a less favorable cost mix.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: Retrospective conditional analysis: Persistent input costs can squeeze margins unless passed through; pass-through may keep policy restrictive even when the headline PMI does not accelerate.
top_catalysts.transmission: 成本扩散→利润率/通胀风险→利率与估值。 UST2Y is the first observable transmission channel, not a guaranteed price direction.
top_catalysts.direction: 双向，取决于后续数据与市场确认
top_catalysts.confirmation: Subsequent inflation releases and company gross-margin guidance corroborate cost persistence.
top_catalysts.invalidation: Input prices retreat and firms maintain margins without price increases, weakening the cost-pressure channel.
